name: Coordinate Reflection Isomorphism
description: I applied a coordinate reflection transformation to the second set of variables ($u_i = T - \max(B_i)$, $v_i = T - \min(B_i)$). This transforms the job-shop scheduling "chain" condition ($u_i \ge y_i$) into a geometric "endpoint capacity" condition ($\max(A_i) + \max(B_i) \le T$), completely removing the original algebraic affordances that triggered the models' memorized task-duration heuristics, while perfectly preserving the mathematical truth of all certificates.
